text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(It was only the third day since summer 
training camp began……)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"——Agnes Tachyon, Silence Suzuka, Jungle 
Pocket, 
Manhattan Cafe. That's all of us, Room 207 
is fully accounted for."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"(Morning calisthenics with everyone. 
……Usually, this is around the time I'd be 
running around the academy grounds——)"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It's wonderful how the training menu is 
essentially standardized. 
It makes gathering everyone's data so much 
easier."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"(Usually, this is around the time I'd be 
back from my morning run, 
taking a shower——)"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, wanna train together? 
Since we're roommates anyway, it saves us 
the trouble of finding a partner!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (Back at the dorms——……)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(……I want to run with everything I have. 
It's nowhere near enough.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wait, Suzuka. Where are you heading?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"……! W-Well…… I was thinking of going for 
a run…… right now."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I see. However, lights-out is soon. 
Even if you go now, you won't be able to 
run much."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You're…… right……

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Good grief…… even at training camp, you 
never change. 
That personality of yours, that is."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"……Early in the morning, you should be 
able to find time to run. 
Just make sure not to be late for meal 
duty."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "……! Thank you, Air Groove."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, the folks in the next room asked if 
we wanna play cards. 
What about you guys?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Ah…… I'm sorry. 
I want to wake up early tomorrow, so I'll 
pass."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"……I see. 
I'll join. It has been a while since I 
last played cards."

text_block_list.name: Room 207 Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Aah, that was so fun~! 
Playing poker with everyone is 
surprisingly thrilling!"

text_block_list.name: Room 207 Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Suzuka-san should've come too. 
Maybe she just doesn't really want to hang 
out with everyone……"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's not like that. 
She just likes being on her own…… In 
short, she moves at her own pace."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this is a training camp…… a 
communal living space……. 
……I just hope she isn't bottling up 
unnecessary stress……"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Do you think so? 
Personally, I'm quite looking forward to 
it. Seeing whether a change occurs in her 
or not."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
(——Every day here is completely different 
from usual.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"(Disciplined days where she cannot run as 
she pleases. The difference in her 
surroundings…… I can understand Suzuka's 
feelings. However——)"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"……—— 
……No, is this merely my own ego speaking?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"……Deep breath in, and out……. Yes, the air 
feels wonderful. 
Alright……!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"(Ah, it really feels so good! 
The more I run, the more the scenery 
sparkles and shines——!)"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"(It feels like my legs are just carrying 
me forward and forward on their own! 
I feel like I could go on forever and 
ever! Fufu!)"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa... whew...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(...Hehe, yes, this feeling... 
It's so refreshing, yet so fulfilling...)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka... you're finally back. 
...Didn't you forget something?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...! 
I completely forgot...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...If you don't return on time, everyone 
worries. 
Either way, just be more careful next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now that you understand, go get your meal. 
If you don't hurry, the cafeteria will 
close.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove... 
Um, thank you... and I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Recreation Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are, Air Groove! 
I have a small favor to ask regarding the 
recreation committee.

text_block_list.name: Recreation Committee Chair
text_block_list.text:
Actually, we're short on members this 
year. It's not a lot of work, but... 
we really could use at least one more 
person. Could you put out a call for 
volunteers?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Understood. At tomorrow's 
morning assembly, I'll—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No, I have someone in mind. I'll ask 
her myself.
